name: splunk_api_call
description: Call the Cisco Splunk Enterprise REST API. Rooted at https://<host>:8089. Auth (Bearer token or HTTP Basic) is handled for you; do NOT log in. output_mode=json is added for you on GETs. Returns {status_code, data, error, blast_radius}; config objects (indexes, saved searches, server info) are under data['entry'] (each has 'name' + 'content'), search output is under data['results']. Key endpoints: GET /services/server/info, GET /services/data/indexes, GET /services/saved/searches, POST /services/search/jobs/export (one-shot synchronous search), POST /services/search/jobs (async -> sid), GET /services/search/jobs/{sid} (poll; done when content.dispatchState == 'DONE'), GET /services/search/jobs/{sid}/results. SPL rule: prefix the query with 'search ' unless it starts with '|'. POST bodies are FORM-encoded. Check status_code < 400 before trusting data.

function.name: splunk_api_call
function.description: Call the Cisco Splunk REST API. Auth is handled internally; pass the path from the host root.
